ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution; approximately 55% high-intensity pixels (predominantly left lobe) to 45% low-intensity pixels (predominantly right lobe and surface markings).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe presents as a contiguous high-intensity white field with dark linear noise. Right lobe presents as a contiguous low-intensity black field with localized high-intensity clusters near the distal tip and trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped convergence; pixel-edge analysis suggests an acute angle of approximately 48 degrees; the vertex is partially occluded by water spray.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Left lobe trailing edge is characterized by low-amplitude, smooth topography. Right lobe trailing edge exhibits extreme high-amplitude irregularities including five distinct jagged voids/notches ranging from 15 to 60 pixels in depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Left lobe displays a continuous convex curve to the distal tip. Right lobe trajectory is non-continuous and severely disrupted by significant tissue voids.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-intensity pixel clusters (approximately 3-8 pixels in diameter) scattered across the lower medial and distal regions of the dark right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) crossing the left lobe's high-intensity field; visible secondary lighter linear marks on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Severe traumatic tissue loss and irregular jagged scarring along the entire trailing edge of the right lobe; extensive rake mark scarring across both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Extreme hemispheric pigmentation asymmetry where the left lobe is almost entirely white and the right lobe is almost entirely black.
